title: Severability.
bodyText: If any provision of the state traffic laws is held for any reason invalid by a court of competent jurisdiction, such decision shall not affect the validity of the remaining provisions of the state traffic laws.
bodyHtml: [§291C-174]  Severability.  If any provision of the state traffic laws is held for any reason invalid by a court of competent jurisdiction, such decision shall not affect the validity of the remaining provisions of the state traffic laws. [L 1978, c 111, pt of §2]
